quality.rationale: Current app coverage includes the Japanese サムネいる？ title, English ThumbNailed It? title, shared Need it quick? ThumbNailed It! tagline, footer Manual access, Manual per-feature use cases, localized Privacy Policy and Terms modals with taller desktop layout, X / Twitter footer contact using the official X logo SVG path, GitHub Issues footer link with icon, centered © Sunmax Engineering footer, active-language Animation/アニメ tab label, PWA manifest/service worker, Chrome extension bridge, preview-header Output menu for JPG/PNG/WebP/OBS, top-right edit-state icons with autosave text, motion timeline, existing template/generator/layer/color/Image Lab workflows, CSV/HTML compatibility, automated tests, production build, and Playwright local Chrome runtime gate. Cross-browser, real-device, browser storage quota, and real OBS setup checks remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, static PWA public assets, a same-origin service worker, a page-message extension bridge that reuses edit-state JSON, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: Implementation, README, user guide, requirements, specification, design, test plan, QCDS evidence, tests, build, runtime gate, docs packaging, and branch push workflow are synchronized for the current release state.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested legal modal height, official X icon, Manual use-case, and Manual header copy changes passed validation: Privacy Policy and Terms legal-content had no desktop overflow, X / Twitter contact uses the official X logo path, Manual feature entries show use-case rows, the removed Manual subtitle is absent, WebP export works, mobile overflow is 0, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is real-device, non-Chromium, storage quota, and real OBS capture behavior.

openItemsBeforeReview: Default templates 38 practical layouts with Schedule, Motion, weekly Sunday-start templates, expanded easing, and Motion/OBS preview
